[Council File 26-1293]
Motion (Jurado for Rodriguez – McOsker) relative to instructing the Department of Animal Services (DAS), with assistance from the Department of General Services and any other appropriate City departments, to report on the condition and capital improvement needs of all properties utilized by the DAS.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee approved item(s) (Sep 16, 2026)
